name: Purchase Order Recurring

name: Sale Order Creation Restriction
description:
The Sale Order Create Restriction module allows you to control which users or groups are allowed to create sales orders in Odoo. This ensures that only authorized personnel (such as sales managers or senior staff) can initiate orders, improving data security and sales workflow control.

Ideal for companies that want to restrict unauthorized order creation or enforce a chain of approval in their sales process.
